storyCards.headline: Let Me Blow Ya Mind: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Eve's "Let Me Blow Ya Mind" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 33 weeks on the chart.

Let Me Blow Ya Mind was released in 2001.

Chart story — peaked at #2 on the Hot 100.
